# Twitter / X — 2010

First full NYC winter after Full Sail. Alexis is in the replies (@alexisarmel), Steelers, skiing, Olbermann's blizzard, and the first theological one-liners ('do you really think if Jesus comes back he's going to want to see a fucking cross'). The spreadsheet does not cover this year; every tweet here is from the live scrape and the year is still being walked backward.
